question: In a determination of the activity of an enzyme, the depletion of the substrate:

options.opa: It is essential for most trials.
options.opb: It may give falsely low results in sera with high enzymatic activity.
options.opc: It occurs when the reagent is finished.
options.opd: It occurs due to a defect in the spectrophotometer.
options.ope: It can lead to falsely elevated results in sera with high enzymatic activity.
